new_findings.text: The const-vs-var contrast between the two builds' level caps is decorative, not functional: shs3_android declares levelCap a mutable var, but every one of its references across the whole script tree is a READ (DungeonGenerator, Item, LootDialog, OverworldHUD, ItemGenerator, QuestGenerator, ...). No code path in either build ever assigns it. So 'levels 81-99 are structurally unreachable' is equally true of v0.682 and v0.717, and the web build's 'const' keyword adds nothing on top of the anti-cheat guard that already rejects any level above the cap.
